758:t_1:1100.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll start with being a good daughter, though.」

758:t_1:1101.en:
$$カレン$$
($$ルルーシュ$$... This is the future I chose.)

758:t_1:1103.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「If all you're going to do is watch from a distance, you might as well go join that circle yourself.」

758:t_1:1104.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That is not permitted. The only reason I'm not wearing the mask today is that I'd stand out too much in town.」

758:t_1:1105.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ルルーシュ$$... What do we do from here?」

758:t_1:1107.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Will you take that Japanese government SP job $$扇$$ invited you to?」

758:t_1:1108.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$藤堂$$ has also invited me to join the special unit that's being newly formed.」

758:t_1:1109.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「There's no need to rush an answer. Peaceful days will likely go on for a while.」

758:t_1:1111.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「There is no such thing as eternity. Someone will surely appear someday who breaks this peace...」

758:t_1:1113.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「We fight. That is the mission laid upon us.」

758:t_1:1115.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Well then, we who have no use in times of peace should be on our way.」

758:t_1:1116.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Farewell, $$カレン$$... Congratulations on your graduation.」

758:t_1:1117.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(Thank you, $$アッシュフォード学園$$... I will never forget the days I spent here with $$ナナリー$$ and my friends...)

758:t_1:1118.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(I go forth... not as $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, but as $$ゼロ$$, the man who works miracles...)

758:t_1:1119.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(And I will protect it. This future that $$ナナリー$$... and everyone wished for...)

758:t_1:1120.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
(I swear it to the dead and to my comrades... I will keep fighting forever.)

758:t_1:1124.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...Why do we have to come to $$宗介$$'s school? $$カナメ$$ isn't a protection target anymore, right?」

758:t_1:1125.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Quit complaining, $$ウェーバー$$. A role like this is nice once in a while.」

758:t_1:1126.en:
$$クルツ$$
(That's fine for you... If you come to Japan, you've got your trips to Akihabara to look forward to...)

758:t_1:1129.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's enough griping. Today we're standing in as his family.」

758:t_1:1130.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Standing in as family... Oh, I get it...!」

758:t_1:1131.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. Today is the graduation ceremony at $$陣代高校$$.」

758:t_1:1132.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Though $$相良$$ and $$カナメ$$ ended up never making it to school until today.」

758:t_1:1134.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Well, that part... On top of the Volunteer Club's record of activities, I pulled quite a few strings behind the scenes...」

758:t_1:1135.en:
$$アル$$
「The Sergeant's finest hour rests on the hard work of all sorts of people like that. I simply must see it.」

758:t_1:1136.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So this damn heavy bag is Al's terminal, huh?」

758:t_1:1137.en:
$$アル$$
「Personally, I wouldn't have minded dropping in on you here still in $$レーバテイン$$, but...」

758:t_1:1138.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Without $$ＥＣＳ$$, you'd cause a huge uproar...!」

758:t_1:1139.en:
$$マオ$$
「You take after your partner. You really can't read the room sometimes.」

758:t_1:1140.en:
$$アル$$
「I believe there is room for improvement in the lack of that function. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, please consider introducing it.」

758:t_1:1141.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Eh... Um... You can't just say that to me...」

758:t_1:1142.en:
$$アル$$
「That was a joke. I am confident that I surpass the Sergeant in this department.」

758:t_1:1143.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're even. At a low level.」

758:t_1:1144.en:
$$アル$$
「Now then, everyone... please switch to stealth mode. The Sergeant seems to have arrived.」

758:t_1:1145.en:
$$マオ$$
(Come to think of it, I heard the other graduate went ahead to the school before us, but hasn't she shown up yet...?)

758:t_1:1146.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$! Because you were late, we're barely getting here in time after all!」

758:t_1:1147.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry. It had been so long that I forgot where I'd put my school uniform.」

758:t_1:1148.en:
$$かなめ$$
「At this point, who cares about that! We're graduating by brute force, so we're in no position to sweat trivial things like that!」

758:t_1:1149.en:
$$宗介$$
「A uniform is a student's battle dress. Are you telling me to go onto the battlefield with inadequate equipment?」

758:t_1:1150.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There it is, the battlefield brain, first time in ages...」

758:t_1:1152.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No... it's fine. It's just like you.」

758:t_1:1153.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But, you know... if we'd gone straight to Japan without stopping at $$メリダ島$$, it wouldn't have gotten this hectic, right?」

758:t_1:1156.en:
$$宗介$$
「You remembered. The one about showing you the sea.」

758:t_1:1158.en:
$$宗介$$
「It got put off, but I'm glad I could finally fulfill it.」

758:t_1:1160.en:
$$風間$$
「No mistake! It's $$相良$$ and $$千鳥$$!」

758:t_1:1163.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've come back alive, shown you the sea, gotten you back, and there are prospects for us to graduate together... I can say my promises are nearly fulfilled.」

758:t_1:1164.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You really are a stickler for duty...!」

758:t_1:1165.en:
$$宗介$$
「All that remains is to carry out the promise to you that was left half-done.」

758:t_1:1167.en:
$$宗介$$
「The one where I take you back to $$陣代高校$$ and kiss you.」

758:t_1:1168.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hold on! Wasn't that supposed to be for when we met again...?」

758:t_1:1169.en:
$$宗介$$
「Merely meeting is not enough. Only when I take you back to the $$陣代高校$$ you were taken from can we say we have truly reunited.」

758:t_1:1170.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I-it's always like this, but it sounds logical without actually being logical!」

758:t_1:1172.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course not!? But, look... look around you!」

758:t_1:1176.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But I always wanted this... To go back to school, just the two of us...)

758:t_1:1177.en:
$n
(Honestly, that guy, right to the end...)

758:t_1:1178.en:
$n
(So long, $$宗介$$. And $$千鳥$$, and everyone...)

758:t_1:1179.en:
$n
(Thank you... I will never forget the days I spent at this school...)

758:t_1:1184.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Wait up, $$シンヤ#pilot$$! It's rehab, so you mustn't move your body that suddenly!」

758:t_1:1185.en:
$$シンヤ#pilot$$
「I'm fine, I'm fine! Even my eyes don't hurt at all anymore!」
